## About

Inspired by some interesting experience sharing during our previous events, we are organizing a coworking session on R programming. You're welcome to stay for the entire 2-hour session, or as long as you need within the duration. We will:

- Cowork independently on R-related projects or tasks  
- Ask questions, if any, and exchange ideas and experience  
- Meet other R users in Vienna and our host, Laura  

Instead of working alone at a screen, we would like to trial this event format to bring our community together, and learn from each other through actual human experiences.

As we promote gender diversity and inclusion in the R community, all gender identities and skill levels in R are welcome!

[RSVP via Meetup {{< fa brands meetup >}}](https://www.meetup.com/rladies-vienna/events/317289714){.btn .btn-outline-primary .rsvp}
